name: dev.ucp.shopping.b2b_catalog
title: B2B Catalog Extension (Working Draft)
description: Working Draft for #1110. Extends Catalog Search and Catalog Lookup with the facts a procurement agent needs to shortlist and verify a business-to-business supplier: trade terms (minimum order quantity, quantity brackets, Incoterms), lead time and capacity, supplier type, certifications with a verification level, and product and variant attributes in the #401 shape with a source pointer.

source_pointer.title: Source Pointer
source_pointer.description: Where a fact comes from, so a Platform can check it. Shared by attribute sources, compatibility claims (#385) and certificate evidence. `url`, `page`, `section` and `quote` point at the document that states the fact; `sha256` and `checked_at` say which copy was read and when the quote was last confirmed.

type.description: Who stated the fact. Well-known values: `supplier_authored` (entered by the supplier as structured data), `supplier_document` (extracted from the supplier's own datasheet, catalog or product page), `inferred` (derived by a Platform or Business from other facts). A Platform MUST treat an unrecognized value as `inferred`.

url.description: Location of the document that states the fact, ideally a stable hosted copy.

page.description: 1-based page number within the document at `url`.

section.description: Heading or section within the document (e.g. 'Technical data').

quote.description: The line in the document that states the fact, quoted verbatim.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the bytes of the document at `url` that the quote was read from. Lets a Platform tell which copy a quote came from when the document changes.

checked_at.description: Date the quote was last confirmed in the document.

reason.description: Why this source was chosen when other documents state a different value (e.g. 'Footnote limits the 150 °C rating to the DN50 model'). Present only when such a conflict exists.

attribute.title: Attribute
attribute.description: A product or variant fact with its source. Mirrors the `attribute` shape proposed in #401 (`name`, `key`, `value`, `numeric_value`, `unit`) and adds `source` and `additional_sources`, so that one shape serves both proposals. If #401 is adopted, this definition becomes #401's type plus the two source fields.

name.description: Human-readable attribute name (e.g. 'Max. operating temperature'). As in #401.

key.description: Stable identifier for cross-merchant correlation. As in #401. A Business SHOULD use the identifier from the taxonomy it categorizes by (e.g. an ECLASS property code) when one exists.

value.description: Display value, as stated. As in #401. May hold a range or several numbers (e.g. '60-256 g/m²', '520 x 540 x 634 mm').

numeric_value.description: Comparable numeric form of `value` when the attribute is a single measurement. As in #401. A value with more than one number SHOULD instead be split into one attribute per number (see the spec page).

unit.description: Unit of `numeric_value`. As in #401: open vocabulary, SI/UCUM-style symbols preferred (e.g. `mm`, `kg`, `C`).

source.description: The line `value` was taken from. When several lines state the fact, this is the line that wins. A Business MUST NOT mark safety-critical attributes (e.g. food contact, medical use, pressure rating) as `inferred`.

additional_sources.description: Other lines that state the same fact, including lines that give a different value. When one of them conflicts with `value`, `source.reason` says why `source` wins.

price_bracket.title: Price Bracket
price_bracket.description: Unit price that applies from a minimum quantity, under a stated trade term.

min_quantity.description: Lowest quantity, in steps of the variant's `quantity_unit`, at which this bracket applies.

price.description: Price per one whole `quantity_unit.unit`, as for the variant's `price`.

incoterm.description: Incoterms® 2020 rule the price is quoted under. Well-known values: `EXW`, `FCA`, `CPT`, `CIP`, `DAP`, `DPU`, `DDP`, `FAS`, `FOB`, `CFR`, `CIF`.

named_place.description: UN/LOCODE of the named place or port for `incoterm` (e.g. `CNNGB` for Ningbo).

trade_terms.title: Trade Terms
trade_terms.description: Business-to-business ordering terms for a variant: minimum order and quantity brackets. The ordering step is the variant's `quantity_unit.increment`.

min_order_quantity.description: Minimum order quantity (MOQ), in steps of the variant's `quantity_unit`.

brackets.description: Quantity brackets. When present, a Platform SHOULD resolve the price for a quantity from the bracket with the highest `min_quantity` not above it, for the trade term it needs. These prices are indicative until confirmed in Checkout or a quotation.

supply_signals.title: Supply Signals
supply_signals.description: Lead time and capacity signals a Platform can filter and compare before a cart exists. Indicative; not a delivery promise.

sample_lead_time.description: Typical time to dispatch a sample (e.g. `P7D`).

production_lead_time.description: Typical time to produce an order at the minimum order quantity (e.g. `P25D`).

quantity.description: Quantity that can be produced per `period`.

certification.title: Certification
certification.description: A certification the product holds, with the level to which it has been verified.

valid_until.description: Expiry date as stated on the certificate.

verification.description: How far the claim has been checked, by whom and when. UCP does not run a verification authority; this states the claimed level and its source.

level.description: Well-known values: `self_declared`, `document_checked`, `third_party_verified`. A Platform MUST treat an unrecognized value as `self_declared`.

verified_at.description: Date of the most recent check.

verified_by.description: Who performed the check (e.g. `business`, `platform`, or the name of a third party).

evidence.description: Optional pointer to public evidence, such as a hosted copy of the certificate. It does not replace `valid_until` and `verified_at`.

supplier.title: Supplier
supplier.description: Supplier identity added to the variant's `seller`.

supplier_type.description: Well-known values: `manufacturer`, `trading_company`, `distributor`. For a `distributor`, `supplier_type_evidence` can state whether the maker authorized it.

supplier_type_evidence.description: Kinds of evidence behind `supplier_type`. Well-known values: `business_license`, `certificate_holder_match`, `factory_audit`, `manufacturer_authorization` (the maker has authorized this seller to sell its products).

b2b_variant_fields.title: B2B Variant Fields
b2b_variant_fields.description: The fields this extension adds to a catalog variant.

attributes.description: Variant facts with their sources. Same field name and shape as #401.

b2b_product_fields.title: B2B Product Fields
b2b_product_fields.description: The fields this extension adds to a catalog product.

attributes.description: Product facts with their sources, for facts shared by all variants. Same field name and shape as #401.

b2b_variant.description: A catalog variant with B2B fields.

b2b_lookup_variant.description: A lookup variant (carrying input correlation) with B2B fields.

b2b_product.description: A catalog product with B2B fields. Used by search.

b2b_lookup_product.description: A lookup product with B2B fields, preserving input correlation. Used by lookup.

b2b_detail_product.description: A get_product detail product with B2B fields. Used by get_product.

b2b_search_filters.description: Catalog filters extended with B2B constraints. A Business that does not support a filter MUST ignore it rather than fail the request.

max_min_order_quantity.description: Only return variants whose `min_order_quantity` is at most this value.

certifications.description: Only return products holding all of these schemes.

min_verification_level.description: Only count certifications verified at least to this level, in the order `self_declared` < `document_checked` < `third_party_verified`.

supplier_types.description: Only return variants whose seller has one of these `supplier_type` values.

incoterms.description: Only return variants with a bracket under one of these Incoterms.

max_production_lead_time.description: Only return variants whose `production_lead_time` is at most this duration.

dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.search.description: Catalog search composition with B2B fields (extends dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.search).

dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.lookup.description: Catalog lookup composition with B2B fields (extends dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.lookup).
